title: Mirai_Botnet_Investigation_Scenario_a4a
description: Investigate unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.
levels.solution: Check running services and look for unusual network connections. The suspicious service is likely named 'bot-beacon.service'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and look for unusual network connections.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services that communicate with external hosts.

levels.title: Determine Command-and-Control Server
levels.content: Determine the external host communicating with the compromised system.
levels.solution: Investigate network connections and logs for external communication patterns. The command-and-control server IP address is 192.168.70.5.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate network connections and logs for external communication patterns.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the logs in /var/lib/.botcache/beacon.log for external communication.

levels.title: Identify Target of Flood Attack
levels.content: Identify the system receiving the abnormal volume of network traffic generated by the compromised host.
levels.solution: Analyze network flows to determine the destination of the excessive traffic. The target IP address is 192.168.80.100.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Analyze network flows to determine the destination of the excessive traffic.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the logs in /var/lib/.botcache/flood.log for the target IP address.
